entries.rationale: Tailwind 3 build dependency. Vulnerable braces execution observed only during trusted production compilation using repository-controlled content globs. No execution in backend, worker, Nginx runtime or inspected browser artifact. Production users cannot control the patterns supplied to braces. Reviewed 2026-10-11 for the shared closure GitHub verifier binding: only the read-only verifier dependency, explicit hosted workflow-token bindings and mocked consumer regression tests change. Frontend source, dependency locks, runtime packaging and build patterns are unchanged; canonical browser closure and runtime packaging were independently revalidated against the retained unfiltered hosted OSV report. Reviewed 2026-10-12 for full-capacity IAM no-op continuation: the change affects only coordinator planning, evidence checks, tests and operations documentation. The lockfiles, frontend source/build patterns and runtime packaging are unchanged; the unfiltered OSV scan still reports only the existing dev-only braces advisory, and a canonical browser build excludes braces.
